purpose: Golden datasets for calculation integrity, test oracle validation and AI safety.
importantNotice: These datasets are not production data. They are manually resolved calculation anchors used to verify business logic. If code output differs from expected values beyond tolerance, trigger Stop Condition.

globalRules.percentages: Use decimal representation in calculations unless expected output explicitly says percentage points.
globalRules.rounding: Round only at presentation layer unless the dataset defines a rounded expected output.

ma_valuation_ebitda_multiple_basic.description: Simple EBITDA multiple valuation manually resolved.
ma_valuation_ebitda_multiple_basic.riskIfMismatch: M&A valuation output could be materially wrong.
ma_valuation_ebitda_multiple_basic.disclaimer: Indicative DSS valuation only. Not a fairness opinion.

ma_valuation_equity_value_basic.description: Equity value after subtracting net debt from enterprise value.
ma_valuation_equity_value_basic.formula: netDebt = debt - cash; equityValue = enterpriseValue - netDebt
ma_valuation_equity_value_basic.riskIfMismatch: Closing structure and valuation bridge could be wrong.

ma_waterfall_simple_distribution.description: Simple proceeds distribution after transaction costs and debt repayment.
ma_waterfall_simple_distribution.riskIfMismatch: Seller proceeds could be overstated or understated.

funding_runway_basic.riskIfMismatch: Funding runway could mislead capital planning.
funding_runway_basic.disclaimer: Planning estimate only. Not investment advice.

funding_runway_zero_burn.description: Edge case: zero burn should not produce Infinity in UI.
funding_runway_zero_burn.formula: If monthlyBurn <= 0, runwayMonths must be null/not meaningful.
funding_runway_zero_burn.manualCalculation: Division by zero is not a valid runway. UI must not display Infinity.
funding_runway_zero_burn.riskIfMismatch: UI could show Infinity/NaN or misleading runway.

funding_post_money_and_dilution_basic.description: Basic post-money and new investor ownership.
funding_post_money_and_dilution_basic.formula: postMoney = preMoney + newInvestment; investorOwnership = newInvestment / postMoney
funding_post_money_and_dilution_basic.riskIfMismatch: Dilution and ownership reporting could be materially wrong.
funding_post_money_and_dilution_basic.disclaimer: Planning estimate only. Not investment advice.

compliance_weighted_risk_score_basic.description: Simple weighted supplier risk score using three dimensions.
compliance_weighted_risk_score_basic.riskIfMismatch: Supplier risk prioritization could be wrong.
compliance_weighted_risk_score_basic.disclaimer: DSS risk indicator only. Not legal/compliance certification.

compliance_resilience_score_basic.description: Simple resilience score inverse to risk with mitigation bonus.
compliance_resilience_score_basic.riskIfMismatch: Resilience and supplier status could be overstated.

pmi_synergy_capture_rate_basic.description: Captured synergy as percentage of forecast synergy.
pmi_synergy_capture_rate_basic.disclaimer: DSS tracking metric only. Not guarantee of synergy capture.

pmi_synergy_zero_forecast.description: Edge case: zero forecast should not produce Infinity or NaN.
pmi_synergy_zero_forecast.formula: If forecastSynergies <= 0, captureRate must be null/not meaningful.
pmi_synergy_zero_forecast.manualCalculation: Division by zero is not valid.
pmi_synergy_zero_forecast.riskIfMismatch: UI could show invalid PMI execution metric.

bridge_priority_score_basic.description: Simple bridge priority score based on impact, urgency and confidence.
bridge_priority_score_basic.riskIfMismatch: Bridge priority signals could mis-rank executive attention.
bridge_priority_score_basic.disclaimer: DSS signal priority only. Human review required.

risk_score_likelihood_impact_basic.description: Basic risk score from likelihood and impact on 1-5 scale.
risk_score_likelihood_impact_basic.riskIfMismatch: Risk prioritization and heatmap could be wrong.
risk_score_likelihood_impact_basic.disclaimer: DSS risk indicator only. Not insurance underwriting.

reporting_kpi_variance_basic.formula: varianceAmount = actual - budget; variancePercent = varianceAmount / budget * 100
reporting_kpi_variance_basic.riskIfMismatch: Reporting KPIs could mislead board packs.

executive_module_health_average_basic.description: Average health across five module scores.
executive_module_health_average_basic.riskIfMismatch: Executive dashboard may misstate portfolio readiness.
